title: MITRE-funded papers detecting gravitons near atmosphere

tellings.quote: However, there are papers that have since that were funded by the MITRE Corporation going back 20, 25 years that show that gravitons were both very high frequency and extremely low frequency gravitons were detectable near the Earth's atmosphere.

plain: Research papers paid for by the MITRE Corporation, a US research company that works on government contracts, are said to show that gravitons, the particles thought to carry gravity, could be detected near Earth's atmosphere, at both very high and extremely low frequencies. The researcher Dave Rossi says this, dating the papers to some 20 or 25 years back, without naming the papers themselves. If true, it would mean gravity-related physics was being probed in private far earlier than people assume.
